## Purpose and scope

Describe the issue this PR addresses and link the relevant issue.

## Files changed

Identify the files or areas changed and why. Confirm unrelated changes were excluded.

## Preservation and regression risk

- [ ] No unapproved new features or removal of existing behavior
- [ ] Existing inputs, presets, exports, filenames and cross-tool transfers preserved (or deviations explicitly approved)
- [ ] No secrets, proprietary fixtures or unreviewed third-party assets included
- [ ] Third-party provenance/licensing checked for introduced material

## Verification

List **actual** commands/run URLs and results, including failures and tests not run. For code changes, include unit, build, Playwright and pinned CTK parity checks as relevant.

## Release considerations

Does this require a release-branch change, deployment, new permissions or a manual real-file check? None of those actions is implied merely by merging this PR.
